description: The front door to T3 performance results: compare builds here, then use the focused dashboards to explain regressions, resource cost, network sensitivity, release health, GPU outliers, and batch execution.

links.title: Open Build Trends — recommended starting point

panels.title: Welcome to the T3 performance lab
panels.description: A short map of the dashboard suite and the question each view is meant to answer.

options.content:
This site tracks whether T3 stays fast as the product changes. **Start below** for build-to-build wall time, GPU cost, tail latency, and sample coverage. Use the filters at the top to isolate a test scenario, network profile, workload size, client surface, or device type. The three lxso workers are one **Linux i7-8700 worker** type; the other type is **MacBook Pro**. Individual hosts remain visible on Batch status and as a drill-down where needed. Lower is better for every timing and resource chart.

| Dashboard | What it answers — and why it exists |
|---|---|
| [Overview](/d/t3perf-overview/t3-perf-overview) | **Did performance move?** The fastest way to spot a build regression or improvement and check that enough runs support the comparison. |
| [Build trends](/d/t3perf-build-trends/t3-perf-build-trends) | **How far is each build from the best observed build?** Normalizes several metrics into percentages so broad regressions stand out. |
| [Release comparison](/d/t3perf-releases/t3-perf-release-comparison) | **Are shipped versions getting faster or slower?** Keeps release decisions separate from noisy nightly build detail. |
| [GPU outliers](/d/t3perf-gpu-outliers/t3-perf-gpu-outliers) | **Where was the worst GPU cost in the selected releases?** A triage ranking with an explicit measurement-backend filter; use the build line and linked method note before calling a regression. |
| [Resources](/d/t3perf-resources/t3-perf-resources) | **What is the run costing besides elapsed time?** Breaks out heap, layout, GPU time, and GPU-process CPU. |
| [Network conditions](/d/t3perf-network/t3-perf-network-conditions) | **Does latency or bandwidth change the result?** Separates product cost from network sensitivity. |
| [Batch status](/d/t3perf-batch/t3-perf-batch-status) | **Is the benchmark machinery healthy right now?** Shows queue progress, failures, heartbeat age, current work, and logs; it is operational rather than analytical. |

panels.title: Wall time by build (median)
panels.description: Release-time trend for the selected like-for-like test. Hosts are averaged within each device type; use Batch status for individual worker health.

targets.expr: avg by (device_type, scenario, surface, size, network) (last_over_time(t3perf_wall_ms{time_basis="release", scenario=~"$scenario", stat="median", build!="", label=~"$label", network=~"$network", size=~"$size", surface=~"$surface", device_type=~"$device_type"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Runs per result by build
panels.description: Release-time sample coverage for the selected like-for-like test. Hosts are averaged within each device type; scenario, surface, size, and network stay separate so unlike tests are never merged.

targets.expr: avg by (device_type, scenario, surface, size, network) (last_over_time(t3perf_runs{time_basis="release", scenario=~"$scenario", build!="", label=~"$label", network=~"$network", size=~"$size", surface=~"$surface", device_type=~"$device_type"}[$__interval]))
